About.title: Systems that keep creating value after launch
About.p1: Senior Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience designing and developing scalable web platforms, business management systems, e-commerce solutions, and automation tools.
About.p2: I specialize in building reliable digital products using React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and modern cloud technologies. My experience includes developing custom CRM platforms, API integrations, customer management systems, marketing automation solutions, and AI-powered applications.
About.p3: I have worked with international companies and remote teams, delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency, automate business processes, and create better customer experiences. My approach combines clean architecture, intuitive UX, secure integrations, and long-term scalability.

highlights.h1: Designed and developed scalable web platforms, SaaS applications, marketplaces, and business automation systems using React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL.
highlights.h2: Built custom CRM platforms for customer management, database organization, workflow automation, and business process optimization.
highlights.h3: Developed AI-powered chatbot systems and intelligent assistants that automate customer communication and generate personalized responses.
highlights.h4: Delivered marketplace platforms with advanced user management, payment integrations, product catalogs, and scalable backend architectures.
highlights.h5: Designed database structures and migration processes for large customer datasets using PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB.
